about: A trailing comment naming a runner and the CLI is no fetch: the command before it runs the devDependency (2.1-M216)

files..github/workflows/release.yml:
jobs:
  build:
    steps:
      - run: npm run tauri -- build # uses @tauri-apps/cli devDependency, not npx
      - run: npm install && npm run tauri build  # @tauri-apps/cli locked
      - run: echo "#1" 'npx' && npm run tauri build # not npx @tauri-apps/cli
files.scripts/build.mjs: run('npm run tauri build'); // never npx @tauri-apps/cli
